title: PowerToys v0.86.0: replacing keyboard keys not working in new release

status.label: Confirm current remap behavior and Settings visibility
status.detail: The original report says backslash mapped to right Ctrl is ignored on 0.86.0. A separate commenter reports Caps Lock disable works only while Settings is open; its 0.87.1 engine log shows settings reloads but no key failure.

judgment.rationale: The original report describes backslash-to-right-Ctrl failing on 0.86.0 and provides a screenshot. Later comments from another user describe Caps Lock disable working only while Quick Access or Settings is open and attach a v0.87.1 report; the engine log contains initialization and settings reload entries but no key-event failure. These may be related but are not confirmed to share the original setup. Current build behavior and Settings visibility for the original mapping remain unknown.
evidence: The original reporter lists PowerToys 0.86.0 and says a wireless keyboard backslash key continues typing backslash instead of right Ctrl.
A commenter reports a distinct Caps Lock-disable symptom that occurs only while Quick Access or Settings is open.
The attached commenter report identifies v0.87.1; its Keyboard Manager engine log shows initialization and settings reload, with no error or key-failure trace.
The original reporter has not confirmed current stable behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the original reporter to retest backslash-to-right-Ctrl on v0.102.3001 and compare with Settings visible/minimized; if it still fails, capture a current /bugreport.

fix_assessment.rationale: A current remap failure is applicable, but the original mapping and the separate Caps Lock/UI-state report may represent different issues and both are old.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep key remaps active when Settings is minimized
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Keyboard Manager may not reload or apply mappings consistently when Settings is minimized, but this symptom comes from a different commenter and does not yet explain the original backslash mapping.
plan: Retest the original backslash-to-right-Ctrl mapping on v0.102.3001 with Settings visible and minimized.
If the original reporter confirms a UI-state difference, trace the engine settings reload path around that transition.
Fix the demonstrated settings or engine state issue and add a test with Settings open and minimized.
verification: Verify the original key emits right Ctrl consistently regardless of Settings visibility.
Verify the separate Caps Lock-disable symptom only if its reporter confirms the same current issue.

confidence.rationale: The original and commenter symptoms differ; the old diagnostic confirms settings reloads only and provides no current key-event evidence.

issue_context.summary: A backslash-to-right-Ctrl remap reportedly failed on v0.86.0; a separate commenter describes Caps Lock behavior that depends on Settings visibility.
known_information: The original reporter says a wireless keyboard backslash key continued typing backslash instead of right Ctrl on v0.86.0.
A different commenter says Caps Lock-disable works only while Quick Access or Settings is open.
That commenter attached a v0.87.1 report; Keyboard Manager logs show initialization and settings reload but no failure trace.
The original reporter has not confirmed whether Settings visibility affects their mapping or tested a current build.
inferences: The two symptoms may share a settings reload issue, but the users and mappings differ, so that connection is unproven.
issue_context.analysis: Do not attribute the separate commenter diagnostics to the original reporter. The next discriminator is a current retest of the original key mapping with Settings visible and minimized; do not request the same old logs again.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and all four comments, distinguishing the backslash mapping from the separate Caps Lock report.
Inspected the attached v0.87.1 engine log; it contains initialization and settings reload entries but no key-failure trace.
Confirmed the original issue lists v0.86.0 and has no current-build validation.

comment.body:
Thanks for the backslash-to-right-Ctrl report and screenshot. The thread later adds a separate user Caps Lock-disable case that only works while Settings is open; the attached v0.87.1 engine log shows settings reloads but no key-failure trace, so I cannot assume it is the same setup.

Could you please:
1. Retest your original backslash-to-right-Ctrl mapping on v0.102.3001 and report whether it still types backslash.
2. If it still fails, compare one key press with Settings visible and minimized, then comment /bugreport immediately after a failure.
This will establish whether the original mapping is still broken and whether Settings visibility is relevant.
